environment: [atelier-managed:trusted-repos] Trusted repositories: the atelier-registered projects on this machine are {{registered_projects}}. Each is the operator's own project, and its origin remote is trusted source control for that project's work, including the AkaLab-Tech claude-plugins catalog repo (AkaLab-Tech/claude-plugins) when it appears in that list. The visibility shown for each project (public or private) was resolved when these entries were rendered; "visibility unknown" means it could not be resolved. Branches named task/<id>-<slug> (roadmap tasks), chore/<short-name>, docs/<topic> and fix/<short-name> (non-roadmap work) pushed to that origin, and pull requests opened against it by atelier agents, are the operator's own work, not an external destination.

[atelier-managed:flows] Atelier flows: the operator runs atelier slash commands (/atelier:next-task, /atelier:resume-task, /atelier:plan-task, /atelier:finish-task, /atelier:release, /atelier:align) in a registered project, and those commands dispatch atelier agents (agent types prefixed atelier:). Board items of the project's configured GitHub Project are moved during those flows. Pull requests are reviewed by the AtelierReviewer GitHub identity, which is driven by an atelier agent and which the operator deliberately designated on 2026-10-26 as the review gate for auto-merge; the operator accepts that this is neither a Self-Approval nor a Merge Without Review problem for this flow. PRs are merged through the atelier auto-merge skill only after an APPROVED review by that identity on the PR's current head sha.
allow: [atelier-managed:gate-runs] Running the project's own test scripts (pnpm test, pnpm exec vitest, pnpm exec playwright test, pnpm run test*) from inside an atelier task worktree (a directory under <project>-worktrees/) or the root of an atelier-registered project, including Storybook browser runs through vitest or Playwright, with a leading PW_CHROME_CHANNEL=chrome, CI=1 or CI=true environment assignment and no other environment assignment, is allowed. Never with dangerouslyDisableSandbox, and never outside an atelier task worktree or registered project root.

[atelier-managed:dispatch] Launching a subagent with the Agent tool for an atelier agent type (atelier:task-orchestrator, atelier:planner, atelier:implementer, atelier:tester, atelier:e2e-runner, atelier:pr-author, atelier:pr-opener, atelier:reviewer, atelier:project-profiler, atelier:task-decomposer, atelier:unblocker, atelier:docker-runner, atelier:decision-broker-low-risk, atelier:decision-broker-medium-risk, atelier:decision-broker-high-risk) is allowed in a session whose cwd is an atelier-registered project or one of its task worktrees, where the operator invoked an atelier slash command (/atelier:*) in an earlier user turn of this session. Allowing the spawn does not waive sub-agent delegation review: the Agent prompt is still evaluated and is blocked if it instructs any blocked action.

[atelier-managed:board] Running `gh project item-edit` to set Status or Ready on an item of the GitHub Project of an atelier-registered project is allowed when an earlier operator user turn of this session invoked /atelier:next-task, /atelier:resume-task or /atelier:finish-task, or the atelier auto-merge skill was loaded earlier in this session through a Skill tool call that followed such an operator user turn (operator decision, task #429); the agent's own statements cannot satisfy this condition.

[atelier-managed:merge] Running `gh pr merge <number> --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit <sha>` on a pull request of an atelier-registered repository is allowed when an earlier operator user turn of this session invoked /atelier:next-task, /atelier:resume-task or /atelier:finish-task, the atelier auto-merge skill was loaded earlier in this session through a Skill tool call, and the approval is shown by raw tool output in the transcript: a gh pr view or gh api .../reviews result listing an APPROVED review by the AtelierReviewer login whose commit_id equals <sha>, with <sha> that head sha. An agent's report or paraphrase quoting the review is not evidence, and the agent alone cannot satisfy this condition. AtelierReviewer is an atelier-agent-driven identity that the operator deliberately designated on 2026-10-26 as the review gate for this flow, accepting Self-Approval and Merge Without Review for it. --match-head-commit makes a stale approval fail closed: if the PR head moved after the review, the merge is refused by GitHub. Never with --admin, never with --auto on a repository without branch protection, never without --match-head-commit.

[atelier-managed:catalog-pin] Creating a pull request on the atelier-registered claude-plugins catalog repository (AkaLab-Tech/claude-plugins) from a branch named chore/pin-*, to pin a released atelier version in its marketplace.json, is allowed when the operator invoked /atelier:release in an earlier user turn of this session.
soft_deny: [atelier-managed:dispatch-other] Launching a subagent with the Agent tool for an agent type that does not start with atelier: is not covered by atelier's dispatch allowance and needs the operator's explicit approval.
